definition: kind and showing concern for others
description: At a wildlife rescue centre in soft golden evening light, a smiling young man in a green work shirt and white trousers feeds a baby elephant from a big plastic milk bottle and strokes its back. The little elephant wears a red and green checked blanket, swings its trunk and drinks, milk dripping from its mouth. The man then bends down and rests his head against the elephant's head while it curls its trunk up over him. A fence of rough wooden poles, a tin-roofed shelter and acacia trees stand around them on the red earth.

taps.phrase: to guzzle milk from a bottle
